prompt: Which pair of attachments would support Nell’s note about the hinge change?
promptZh: 哪一組附件最能支持妮爾對鉸鏈變更的說明？

options.text: The approved deeper-shelf drawing, plus a photograph of her test door shut with the block in place.
options.zh: 核准的較深層板圖，以及她的試驗門關著、木塊放在定位的照片。
options.whyZh: 圖面確實是實際改鉸鏈前的依據。可是關門的照片不能顯示開門時，門是否避開了代表管子的木塊。

options.text: The approved deeper-shelf drawing, plus a photograph of her test door open past the block.
options.zh: 核准的較深層板圖，以及她的試驗門打開、避開木塊的照片。
options.whyZh: 核准的圖是撞到管子、必須改鉸鏈前使用的方案。自己搭的框架在與真實管子相同的距離放木塊，照片又顯示門打開時能避開它。

options.text: Her pencil tracing with the hinge moved to the other side, plus a photograph of her test door open past the block.
options.zh: 她用鉛筆把鉸鏈畫到另一側的描圖，以及她的試驗門打開、避開木塊的照片。
options.whyZh: 開門測試照片能證明改善，但鉛筆描圖的方案沒有採用，不是實際造成開門碰管子、後來必須重新調整的方案。

options.text: The initial shallow-shelf sketch, plus a photograph of her test door open on a bench with nothing next to the frame.
options.zh: 最初的淺層板草圖，以及她的試驗門在旁邊沒有障礙物的工作臺上打開的照片。
options.whyZh: 淺層板是更早的版本，不是改鉸鏈前所依據的版本。沒有重現管子所占的位置，照片也不能顯示門有沒有避開它。

explanationZh: 核准的圖是撞到管子、必須改鉸鏈前使用的方案。自己搭的框架在與真實管子相同的距離放木塊，照片又顯示門打開時能避開它。
evidence: For the plan-adjustment placement, include an earlier drawing / It must show the part in the position that made the difference, with the same obstruction or limit that the customer has. / send the drawing that shows the plan immediately before the change you describe. / She put that idea aside without using it. / When she tried the approved layout beside the customer’s wall pipe, the open door hit the pipe. / Moving the hinge inward let the door clear it. / The block sits at the same distance from the cabinet as the real pipe.

vocabulary.note: 木工可用切割後的小塊材料試接合，而不用耗用正式板材。
